# Civensa

> Evidence-led research on UK public procurement: buyer intent, contract renewals, supplier requirements and market structure.

Civensa is a UK public procurement directory. It brings together public evidence across buyer plans, contract cycles, supplier requirements and market structure. Entries distinguish published facts, calculated milestones and qualified interpretation.

## Primary pages

- [Research](https://civensa.com/research/): All Civensa research notes.
- [Methodology](https://civensa.com/methodology/): Source hierarchy, evidence standards and limitations.
- [Compare approaches](https://civensa.com/compare/): Transparent comparison of procurement research approaches.
- [Procurement tools directory](https://civensa.com/tools/): Dated, source-linked records for tender alerts, procurement intelligence, bid-writing software, services and official portals.
- [Tender-alert shortlist builder](https://civensa.com/tools/tender-alerts/): Filter 29 providers by product class, price, named portal and must-have features; compare a disclosed 68% feature and 32% headline-value score.
- [Tools directory methodology](https://civensa.com/tools/methodology/): Inclusion rules, evidence labels, pricing checks and corrections.
- [About](https://civensa.com/about/): Directory purpose and approach.

## Citation and contact

When citing Civensa, preserve the article title, canonical URL and publication date. Contact research@civensa.com for research queries.
